attributes.name: Primal Hide Armor
attributes.powers:
Display this card when you play an ally. While displayed, treat that ally as it has the Animal trait. At the end of the turn, discard this card.

Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 2.

Banish this card to reduce all damage deal to you to 0; if proficient with light armors, bury it instead.

If proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
